autyism-le.config.comment.blockPicker: Block and item lists of Litematica / MaLiLib mods (e.g. skip placement list, printer lists) open a searchable picker with icons and names instead of typing IDs. Standing and wall forms (signs, torches, banners, heads...) are one entry, and middle-clicking a block in the world adds it. The original editor is behind the button at the top right.
autyism-le.config.comment.saveEditButton: Adds 'Save edits' (overwrite the placement's .litematic) and 'Save as...' buttons to the placement configuration screen, so Schematic Preview replacements and Edit Schematic changes survive a restart.
autyism-le.config.comment.infoOverlayFlu: The hover info box also compares schematic vs world for fluids and entities (item frames, minecarts, armor stands...).
autyism-le.config.comment.translucentSch: Schematic entities are rendered semi-transparent like ghost blocks (uses Litematica's ghost block alpha), so they can't be confused with real entities.
autyism-le.config.comment.waterloggedMar: When a block's waterlogging differs from the schematic, draw a blue 'W' on every face on top of the yellow wrong-state overlay, also when other properties are wrong too. With a wrong orientation as well, the red 'D' and the 'W' are drawn side by side.
autyism-le.config.comment.materialListEn: Material lists also count schematic entities (item frames, minecarts...) and offer a container contents list.
autyism-le.config.comment.verifierContai: The schematic verifier also checks container contents. Containers whose items differ are listed as 'Wrong contents' in the verifier's result list and are highlighted in the world when you select that category or one of its entries, like Litematica's own categories.
autyism-le.config.comment.signReplaceFix: Replacing a sign's wood in the material list converts all four sign forms to the same form of the target wood and keeps rotation, facing, waterlogged and the text. ALE's own Replace always does this; this option is for Schematic Preview's Replace.
autyism-le.config.comment.renderThroughG: Schematic ghost blocks and overlays (error markers) stay visible behind glass and stained glass, and error markers stay clearly visible on water, bubble columns, ice and other see-through blocks.
autyism-le.gui.button.save_edits.hover:
Overwrite this placement's .litematic file with the current (edited) schematic.
Includes Schematic Preview replacements and Edit Schematic changes.
autyism-le.gui.button.save_as.hover:
Save the current (edited) schematic as a new .litematic file next to the original.
Hold Shift when confirming to overwrite an existing file.
autyism-le.message.save_edits.no_file: This placement has no schematic file (in-memory schematic) - use Save as
autyism-le.message.save_edits.not_litema: %s is not a .litematic file and can't be overwritten - use Save as
autyism-le.message.sign_replaced: Replaced %s signs with %s (form, facing, waterlogged and text kept)
autyism-le.gui.button.container_contents:
Total of all items inside the schematic's containers (chests, shulker boxes, barrels, hoppers...), item frames, armor stands and container minecarts.
Shulker box items inside containers are also expanded.
autyism-le.message.verifier.container_mi: %s containers have different contents than the schematic (magenta boxes)
autyism-le.gui.button.pick_blocks.hover: Open a searchable picker with icons and names: click + to add, - to remove.
autyism-le.gui.button.clear_list.hover: Hold Shift and click to remove every entry.
autyism-le.config.comment.orientationMar: When a block faces the wrong way (facing, axis, rotation, rail direction, wall/floor/ceiling, door hinge, top/bottom half), draw a red 'D' on every face on top of the yellow wrong-state overlay, also when other properties are wrong too. With wrong waterlogging as well, the 'D' and the blue 'W' are drawn side by side.
autyism-le.config.comment.markerPriority: When a block has several markers, draw only the most important one: orientation D first, then waterlogged W, then needs-filling F. Off: D and W side by side, with F always last.
autyism-le.config.comment.fillMarker: Containers whose block in the schematic holds items (hoppers, droppers, dispensers, chests, barrels, shulker boxes, furnaces, brewing stands, crafters...) get a green 'F' on every face, so you can see which ones still need filling without opening each one.
autyism-le.config.comment.containerCheck: Off by default. When on, keeps checking the containers of nearby schematics (no verifier needed): a container that holds things but not what the schematic says (wrong items, too many or too few, wrong slots, different disabled crafter slots) gets a bright box seen through walls. Empty ones still get the F. On a server this needs Servux there (the contents come from the server; only containers that need checking are asked for).
The color of the boxes around containers with wrong contents.
autyism-le.config.comment.containerSlotH: When a container of the schematic is opened, every slot is compared with the schematic: missing items are drawn as faded ghosts (hover shows what goes there), wrong items are marked red, extra ones purple, wrong counts or disabled crafter slots orange.
autyism-le.config.comment.containerSearc: With Container Searcher installed, the containers around you are added to its list without opening them: in single player straight from the world, on a server through Servux (needs Servux on the server and Litematica's entity data sync on). Only loaded chunks; a few containers per tick, each again every minute.
autyism-le.config.comment.fillMarkerSkip: Don't mark containers that hold nothing but items from the list below in the schematic (by default all shulker boxes, for example the hoppers full of empty shulker boxes under a box loader).
autyism-le.config.comment.signHighlightP: With "Highlight Signs" on in the Schematic Verifier, signs with text that are already placed in the world are marked through walls in this color (bright green by default).
autyism-le.config.comment.signHighlightM: Signs with text that are in the schematic but not placed yet use this color (dark green by default).
Marks signs with text inside the schematic through walls (many schematics put hints on signs where things need filling). Bright green: placed; dark green: in the schematic, not placed yet.
autyism-le.config.comment.easyPlaceExact: With ALE on the server too (single player counts), Easy Place puts rails down directly in the schematic's shape: ascending rails and curves in one go, without placing other rails first, and rails that are already placed don't get bent. An ascending rail waits until the block on its high side is there. Without ALE on the server, Easy Place works as before.
autyism-le.message.rail_needs_floor: %s needs a block below it first
autyism-le.message.rail_needs_high_side: %s goes up to the %s: place the block on that side first
autyism-le.config.comment.schematicBrows:
Litematica's schematic browser gets a layout button (list, list with previews, grids of 5, 4 or 3), 3D thumbnails, a rotatable 3D preview of the selected schematic with full screen and free camera, and custom folder icons.
Not used while Schematic Preview is installed (it provides these itself).
autyism-le.config.comment.materialListRe:
Each row of the material list gets a Replace button: every block of that material in the schematic becomes the block you pick. Facing, half, waterlogging and other matching states are kept, and signs keep their text. In the dialog, standing and wall forms are one entry and middle-clicking a block in the world picks it.
With Schematic Preview installed, its Replace button opens this dialog too; Schematic Preview's own dialog is behind the button at the top right.
autyism-le.config.comment.openConfigGui: Hotkey that opens this settings screen. Not bound by default.
autyism-le.config.comment.browserLayout: How the schematic browser shows its entries. The button at the top-left of the browser switches this too.
autyism-le.config.comment.browserGapX: Space in pixels between grid tiles.
autyism-le.config.comment.browserGapY: Space in pixels between list rows and between grid rows.
autyism-le.config.comment.browserListRow: Height of a row in the plain list.
autyism-le.config.comment.browserPreview: Height of a row in the list with previews (the thumbnail grows with it).
autyism-le.config.comment.browserTileHei: Height of a grid tile compared to its width: 1.0 makes square tiles.
autyism-le.config.comment.thumbnailMaxVo: Schematics whose enclosing volume (width x height x length) is larger get no thumbnail in the lists and show 'Too large' instead, so big folders stay fast. The large preview of the selected schematic is not limited by this.
autyism-le.config.comment.previewBlockEn: Draw chests, signs, banners, beds, skulls and other block entities in thumbnails and in the 3D preview.
autyism-le.config.comment.previewFov: Field of view of the 3D preview camera, in degrees.
autyism-le.config.comment.previewYaw: Horizontal angle the preview starts with (thumbnails always use it).
autyism-le.config.comment.previewPitch: Vertical angle the preview starts with: positive values look down on the schematic.
autyism-le.preview.button.freecam_on:
Turn on free camera
Fly with your movement keys, drag to look around

autyism-le.gui.button.pick_item.hover: Choose the item in a searchable list (the last one you add is used)

autyism-le.gui.icon_placement.large: Icon: large, in the picture area
autyism-le.gui.icon_placement.preview: Icon: small, plus a preview of a schematic inside

Where the icon is shown. Changes are visible right away;
Cancel undoes them.
autyism-le.gui.button.reset_icon.hover: Go back to the default icon

autyism-le.message.verifier.container_mi: %s containers have different contents than the schematic. Select 'Wrong Contents' in the Schematic Verifier list to highlight them.
autyism-le.gui.button.original_list.hove:
Open MaLiLib's original list editor (type IDs by hand, change the order).
Its 'Pick blocks...' button brings you back here.
autyism-le.gui.label.replace.pick_hint: %s on a block in the world picks it
autyism-le.message.replace.pick_nothing: There is no block to pick there
autyism-le.gui.button.original_replace.h: Open Schematic Preview's own Replace dialog instead.
autyism-le.hotkeys.category.tools: ALE: wrong block guide & schematic diff
autyism-le.config.comment.locateWrongBlo: A hotkey ("Next Wrong Block") picks the nearest schematic position that is wrong or missing, in the loaded area of the enabled placements (inside the render layer range), and an arrow on the screen plus a box seen through walls lead you there. It goes away when the block is right.
autyism-le.config.comment.locateMode: Missing blocks only, wrong ones only (wrong block, wrong state, extra block), or both.
autyism-le.config.comment.locateBoxColor: Color of the box around the block the guide points at.
autyism-le.config.comment.locateArrowCol: Color of the arrow under the crosshair.
autyism-le.config.comment.locateNext: Go to the nearest wrong or missing block; press again for the next one (one not shown yet in this round). Not bound by default.
autyism-le.config.comment.locatePrevious: Go back to the block shown before (ones fixed in the meantime are skipped). Not bound by default.
autyism-le.config.comment.locateClear: Hide the arrow and the box. Not bound by default.
autyism-le.config.comment.schematicDiff: "Compare with..." in a placement's settings: compare the placement with another version of the schematic (a .litematic file) and show what was added, removed and changed, right on the placement, through walls.
autyism-le.config.comment.schematicDiffS: Show the diff's boxes in the world (the list and the counts stay).
autyism-le.config.comment.schematicDiffA: Blocks only the new version has.
autyism-le.config.comment.schematicDiffR: Blocks only the old version has.
autyism-le.config.comment.schematicDiffC: Same position, another block or state.
autyism-le.config.comment.schematicDiffM: At most this many boxes (the nearest ones) are drawn; the list has all of them.
autyism-le.config.comment.schematicDiffT: Toggles "Schematic Diff: Show Boxes". Not bound by default.
autyism-le.config.comment.schematicDiffO: Opens the list of the diff that is shown. Not bound by default.
autyism-le.message.locate.no_previous: No earlier wrong block to go back to
autyism-le.message.locate.disabled: The wrong block guide is turned off in ALE's settings
autyism-le.message.locate.only_one: This is the only wrong block left in the loaded area
autyism-le.message.locate.none: No wrong or missing blocks in the loaded area
autyism-le.message.diff.none: No schematic diff is shown ("Compare with..." in a placement's settings)
autyism-le.gui.button.diff.compare.hover: Compare the placement with the selected schematic file
Compare this placement with another version of the schematic and show the differences on it
autyism-le.gui.label.diff.truncated: (the list and the boxes keep the first %s)
autyism-le.gui.label.diff.offset: Offset of the other schematic: %s %s %s (shift: 10 per click)
autyism-le.config.comment.materialSource:
Containers you choose with the hotkey below count for material lists: their items are available too (the list screen and the info HUD), so "missing" accounts for them. Shulker boxes inside them count with what they hold.
Contents are known without opening in single player, and on servers with Servux (Litematica's entity data sync on); otherwise open the container once. The last contents seen are kept with the list (per world / server). A container never seen shows as unknown and is not counted.

Look at a container (chest, barrel, shulker box, hopper, dispenser, crafter...) and press this to count it for material lists; press it again on a chosen container to remove it. A double chest counts as one. Not bound by default.
Chosen containers get a thin outline (through walls) while a material list is shown on screen or in the info HUD. On: always. Containers with unknown contents get a fainter outline.
Color of the outline around chosen material containers.
autyism-le.config.comment.schematicNameF: Placements called "Unnamed" (the name of a schematic saved from an area selection that was never renamed) and Syncmatica entries named after a hash show a real name in the placement list, material list, verifier, info HUD and Syncmatica's list: the file's own name, its file name, a file in your schematics folders with the same content, its region names, or its author and size. Only what is shown changes; saved names stay as they are.
autyism-le.message.material_source.not_c: Look at a container to choose it for material lists
autyism-le.message.material_source.off: Chosen material containers are turned off in ALE's settings
autyism-le.gui.button.material_sources.h: Items in these chosen containers count as available:
autyism-le.gui.label.material_sources.un: §econtents unknown yet§7 (open it once; on a server, Servux shows it without opening)
autyism-le.gui.label.material_sources.cl: §7Left-click: check them all again. Right-click: forget them all.
autyism-le.name.author: Unnamed by %s
autyism-le.gui.button.diff.preview.hint: Only the blocks that differ: added and changed ones as the new version has them, removed ones as red glass
